_doc: Real-NVMe bottleneck confirmation + wal shard-scaling on c4d-standard-16-lssd (Titanium NVMe), 4 vCPU pin. Uses --server-stats (SRV_STATS: cpu_cores/inflight/durwait) to confirm on NVMe what the local Docker probe showed: memory is CPU-bound, wal is fsync-bound (CPU-idle). Sweeps wal shards (4/8/16) to test whether wal throughput scales with parallel fsync lanes (the documented lever) rather than CPU. 500k streams (heaviest checkpoint/fsync pressure); shorter ladder since wal plateaus early on fsync and memory saturates cores by ~a few pods.
